cim_eredeti: How Legora is transforming legal work with OpenAI
szoveg_eredeti:
What can lawyers achieve when time is no longer the limit? Discover how Legora uses OpenAI models, ChatGPT and Codex to help legal teams review contracts faster, broaden their analysis and make more room for work that needs human judgment. Part of Intelligence at Work, a series exploring how businesses are putting AI to work. 

Read the full story: https://openai.com/index/legora-agentic-operating-system-for-legal-work/
